title: Set mf-ic-2:3306 to OFFLINE_SOFT?
description: No new traffic goes to mf-ic-2:3306; queries and transactions already on it finish.
statements: /*myflames:proxysql_op*/ UPDATE mysql_servers SET status = 'OFFLINE_SOFT' WHERE hostgroup_id = 30 AND hostname = 'mf-ic-2' AND port = 3306;
checks: Refresh this place. Servers shows mf-ic-2:3306 as ProxySQL runs it, and its inspector shows the configuration row in memory.
If memory changed and runtime did not, the UPDATE ran and LOAD MYSQL SERVERS TO RUNTIME did not: the Configuration line then says a change is not loaded to runtime. Load servers to runtime, or undo.
The Audit log keeps this attempt as Outcome unknown; nothing is sent again.

policy.text: Connection ProxySQL lab is a Development connection. myflames asks only before risky writes, and these 2 statements include one.
